items.title: Fiserv (FISV) Stock May Still Be Cheap As Activist Pressure Builds
items.summary: Fiserv stock has fallen sharply over the past year, yet on current checks it still screens as cheap. This sets up a clear debate for investors looking at whether the recent share price lines up with the company’s fundamentals. Fiserv shares are down 60.7% over the past year, which puts pressure on the case that the current price already reflects recent setbacks.
